candidates.old:
SEC
    SBC wa_rows_base_lo,Y
    PHA                             \ the offset in the row, low byte
    TXA                             \ X = wa_off + 1 still
    SBC wa_rows_base_hi,Y           \ high byte 0..2: the offset is under &280
    LSR A                           \ C = bit 0 of it, A = bit 1
    TAX
    PLA
    ROR A
    CPX #1                          \ C = bit 1
    ROR A
    LSR A                           \ the column, 0..&4F
    CMP #80 - 11                    \ BUGS #10: 69-79 may be a mover left of the view
    BCS late_column                 \ (and C clear on the way on, for the add)
.column_known
    ADC viewport_left_low
    STA wa_x_lo
    LDA viewport_left_high
    ADC #0
    STA wa_x_hi
.y_of_row
    TYA                             \ y = &C7 - (row * 8 + the line in the cell)
    ASL A
    ASL A
    ASL A                           \ C = 0: row <= 25
    EOR #&FF
    ADC #&C8                        \ &C7 - row * 8, its low 3 bits 111; C clear only for row 25
    BCC row_25
.y_known
    STA wa_y
    LDA wa_off
    AND #&07
    TRB wa_y                        \ less the line in the cell (65C02 opcode)
    RTS
candidates.new:
CMP wa_rows_base_lo,Y           \ C = no borrow: the offset's low byte less the row's start (0 or &80)
    TXA                             \ X = wa_off + 1 still
    SBC wa_rows_base_hi,Y           \ high byte 0..2: the offset is under &280
    LSR A                           \ C = bit 0 of it, A = bit 1
    TAX
    LDA wa_off                      \ the offset in the row, low byte: less 0 or &80 is bit 7 flipped
    EOR wa_rows_base_lo,Y           \ (every row start's low byte is 0 or &80)
    ROR A
    CPX #1                          \ C = bit 1
    ROR A
    LSR A                           \ the column, 0..&4F
    CMP #80 - 11                    \ BUGS #10: 69-79 may be a mover left of the view
    BCS late_column                 \ (and C clear on the way on, for the add)
.column_known
    ADC viewport_left_low
    STA wa_x_lo
    LDA viewport_left_high
    ADC #0
    STA wa_x_hi
.y_of_row
    CPY #25                         \ row 25 (or 26: the ring's hidden columns): rare
    BCS y_row_25_cc
    LDA wa_off                      \ y = &C7 - (row * 8 + the line in the cell): the row's &C7 - row * 8
    AND #&07                        \ (its low 3 bits 111) less the line, which EOR does to 111
    EOR wa_y_of_row_table,Y
    STA wa_y
    RTS
.wa_y_of_row_table                  \ &C7 - row * 8, rows 0-24
FOR yk = 0..24
    EQUB &C7 - yk * 8
NEXT
.y_row_25_cc
    CLC                             \ row_25 wants C clear (the ADC left it so)
    BRA row_25                      \ 65C02 opcode
.y_known
    STA wa_y
    LDA wa_off
    AND #&07
    TRB wa_y                        \ less the line in the cell (65C02 opcode)
    RTS
candidates.summary: Both changes in one: (a) the row start's low byte is only ever 0 or &80, so the low-byte subtraction is CMP (for the borrow) and, after the high byte is done, LDA wa_off / EOR base_lo (a subtract of 0 or &80 is bit 7 flipped), replacing SEC/SBC/PHA/PLA; (b) y = &C7 - row*8 - line from a 25-byte table EOR'd with the line (low 3 bits of the table entry are 111, so EOR of the line is the subtraction), replacing TYA/ASL x3/EOR/ADC/BCC and the STA/LDA/AND/TRB; the row 25/26 test is CPY #25 / BCS to a CLC/BRA row_25 stub, y_known kept for row_25's A=&C7 entry. Overlaps the other two candidates (it is both).
candidates.equivalence: Column part: wa_rows_base_lo[k] = LO(k*&280) = (k*&80) & &FF is 0 or &80 for every k, so A - base_lo = A EOR base_lo (mod 256), and CMP base_lo,Y leaves C = (wa_off >= base_lo) = the NO-borrow carry that SEC/SBC left for the high-byte SBC; A, X, C on reaching ROR A are exactly the old ones (A = low byte less the row start, X = bit 1 of the high byte difference, C = its bit 0; EOR/LDA leave C alone as PLA did); N/Z are not read before ROR. Y and the stack are unchanged (the stack is now not used). Y part: all entries to y_of_row (fall-through from column_known, BCC y_of_row and BRA y_of_row from late_column) have only Y = row live. Old: row 0..24 gives C set from ADC #&C8 and y = &C7-8*row, then TRB clears from it the bits of wa_off&7 (its low 3 bits being 111, that is 7-(wa_off&7)); rows 25/26 (Y is at most 26: the tables have 27 entries, INY at most from 25) give 8*row = 200/208, EOR #&FF + &C8 does not carry, so BCC row_25 with C clear. New: CPY #25/BCS takes exactly Y>=25 (that is the same set), through CLC so row_25 sees C clear as before, A unused there; Y<25: wa_y = (wa_off&7) EOR (&C7-8*Y) = (&C7-8*Y) with the low 3 bits 111 EOR line = the old TRB result. y_known (reached only from row_25 with A=&C7) is the old code unchanged. wa_y is the only output; callers (list_live, record_live) reload A/X/Y and do not read flags; C and Z/N on exit differ from before and are not used (list_finish starts with SEC, record_live with PLY/LDA). 3000 passes of passlock (seed 3, --screen) identical to the control; worldcheck --world over the whole world: 26,924 records, 0 disagreeing, same as the control.
candidates.relies_on: Page crossings (checked by building with the candidate and reading the symbol dump, 2026-10-22): world_of_address is &A073-&A0F4 in the bench build; its tables follow. wa_rows_guess (indexed by X 0..63) is at &A0F5-&A134 today, so it crosses into page &A1 and X>=11 pays +1; the candidate moves it to &A115-&A154, all in page &A1, no crossing. wa_rows_base_lo/hi (Y 0..26) are in page &A1 before and after (&A155-&A16F / &A170-&A18A). The new table wa_y_of_row_table is &A0BE-&A0D6 (Y 0..24), inside page &A0, no crossing. Everything after the tables in bank 4 (sky.6502 / kindcache.6502) slides up by the candidate's growth; not checked beyond the measurement below. Relies on wa_rows_base_lo's contents being 0 or &80 (the FOR k = 0..26 EQUB LO(k * &280) below the routine, which this candidate does not touch). Measured on the bench build (2026-10-22, pcprof --detail, seed 1 1500 passes / RIGHT 600 passes): render+logic 32,870 -> 32,814 (-56) on seed 1 and 38,661 -> 38,599 (-62) on RIGHT. Label uses: y_known stays (row_25's BRA y_known), y_of_row stays (late_column's BCC and BRA), column_known and late_column untouched; new labels wa_y_of_row_table, y_row_25_cc are unique to this and the second candidate.
